subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: Should #88204 be split into separate canonical work items for TUI startup routing, sessions_send channel routing, Weixin usage-family proof, background-event isolation, and session activity ordering?
rationale: Current source confirms multiple unresolved slices, but the issue crosses core Gateway/TUI behavior, external Weixin plugin ownership, and product-level background-event/activity semantics that one autonomous patch should not decide.

options.title: Split and Route Subproblems
options.body: Keep #93255 and #51028 as canonical slices, then open or assign focused follow-ups for TUI startup routing, Weixin usage-family proof, and background-event isolation.

options.title: Keep As Umbrella
options.body: Leave this issue open as the umbrella tracker and block automation until maintainers reproduce the Weixin and flood/deadlock paths live.

options.title: Close After Full Coverage
options.body: Close this issue only after linked canonical issues or merged PRs cover every reported behavior with current-main proof.

recommendation.title: Split and Route Subproblems
recommendation.body: Keep #93255 and #51028 as canonical slices, then open or assign focused follow-ups for TUI startup routing, Weixin usage-family proof, and background-event isolation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal for Sessions UX, TUI-adjacent proof, and product-level session behavior decisions among the likely owners.
